synonyms: My daughter was an unsold slave elf.
synopsis: Weiss, witnesses an elf girl being sold into slavery. When he realizes that the girl is not just any elf, but a rare High Elf, he decides to buy her and raise her like a daughter. Weiss finds himself raising a child for the first time. Thanks to his efforts, the girl, who was abused and unable to speak, regains her health. He decides to name her "Lily," after the first word she spoke. Weiss, suddenly a parental figure, now has a new goal, to get Lily into the magic academy! (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: Youmuin-san wa Yuusha ja Arimasen no de
titleRomaji: Youmuin-san wa Yuusha ja Arimasen no de
titleNative: 用務員さんは勇者じゃありませんので
synopsis: A certain girl genius with more power than knowledge accidentally summoned dozens of students and teachers into a dangerous world filled with beasts and magic, but the protagonist isn’t a student or the homeroom teacher… it’s the janitor. At the time of their summoning, the students and teachers each gained a power formed from their soul, but not the janitor. As the janitor was about to be bestowed with a power that would protect him, his power was forcibly taken from him by an arrogant student. Having gone three years without a contract extension, he failed to get a job after having graduated from a third-rate university. Somehow he is still a contractor at 25 years old and was a janitor for 2 years, with a take-home monthly salary of less than ¥120,000. From a society that rejected him, he was thrust into a world that rejected him. And what janitor-san wished from the Goddess who took pity on him was…

synopsis: Leafe, the eldest daughter of a duke, is the reincarnation of the dark magician Laurie. In her previous life, she was feared as an evil woman of unparalleled wickedness and lived a solitary life. In this life, she has avoided loneliness and has successfully lived a smooth life surrounded by her family and fiancé. However, her younger sister Aria stole her fiancé and kicked her out of the house, returning her to a life of solitude. In order to attend Aria's engagement party and fight back, Leafe asks Oliver, the crown prince of a neighboring country, to be her partner. She thought this would be a one-off, but for some reason Oliver has asked her to marry him!? (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shadows House
synopsis: In the depths of a murky mansion lives a group of enigmatic nobles known as...the Shadow family. With no visible features to speak of, these mysterious aristocrats employ living dolls to act as their “faces.” Kate and Emilico are one such pair of mistress and servant, dwelling in their own little world and learning from each other bit by bit with every new day. But in a house of locked doors, living according to rules from no apparent source—how long can their blissfully peaceful existence truly last...? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
titleRomaji: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
titleNative: ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
synopsis: Sora Akizuki, a second-year high school boy, confesses his feelings for the kouhai girl Miya Fuwa, but she rejects him because she "likes someone else." The person she likes is... Asahi Suzukaze, the head of the mysterious "Clinical Trial Club." Sora joins the club, only to find out that Asahi also has someone she already likes. He is a boy who once saved Asahi, who was seriously ill, by helping her get through a "clinical trial," so she calls him "the prince of clinical trials." But it turns out that boy is Sora, who was a mischievous elementary school kid at the time.........? This is a high-tension "clinical trial" romantic comedy with a complex intersection of love interests! (Source: Young Animal, translated)
